summary: Computes an incremental running average: reads a counter at this+0x2C, increments it, accumulates old_count * previous_average(this+0x50) + input, then divides by the updated counter and stores the result at this+0x50. A counter-wrap guard resets the counter to 1 when the old value is -1 (i.e. the incremented value would be 0). The stored average is then post-processed through a compare-status branch against 120.0 that replaces it with a constant when the comparison is unordered or when it exceeds 120.0.

local_names.v5/v6: compare-status flags from the final comparison (decompiler locals)

v2 := (double)v7 * average at this+0x50 + input a2 — accumulate old_count * old_average plus new input
if v7 == -1: this+0x2C := 1 — reset counter when the increment would produce zero
v3 := v2 / (int)counter at this+0x2C; this+0x50 := v3 — compute and store the new running average
Compare v3 against 120.0: if the comparison status is unordered, this+0x50 := 1116471296; else if v3 > 120.0, this+0x50 := 1123024896
Function completes without a return value; the updated average persists at this+0x50
